# Mochi Moon assets (art, sound, music, voice)

Everything here lives in `src/client/public/assets/` and is copied as-is into `dist/assets/` by `npm run build`
(Vite's `public` folder; the client root is `src/client`). The typed manifest is `src/client/assets.ts`;
playback is `src/client/audio.ts`. The hero chibis are still the hand-made SVGs in `chibi.ts` (not replaced).

**Licence:** every file in `public/assets/` was generated by us for this project: images by the Codex CLI image
generator from our prompts, sound effects and music synthesised from code in `scripts/assets/` (no samples),
voice lines by Gemini TTS from our own text. No third-party samples, stock art, fonts or music are included.

## Images (`assets/img/`, webp)

| File | Size | What | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bg-title.webp` | 1536×1024 | Title / loading background: full moon, lanterns, sleeping mochi on a moon hill | calm middle for the logo |
| `logo.webp` | 1024×504, alpha | "Mochi Moon" wordmark with a mochi face and crescent | the only image with text |
| `bg-shop.webp` | 1536×1024 | Shop backdrop: moon night-market stall, shelves of stardust jars | empty counter in the middle for cards |
| `banner-victory.webp` | 900×574, alpha | Empty cream ribbon, laurel, moon, cheering mochi | put "ชนะ!" / "Victory!" as HTML/canvas text on the ribbon |
| `banner-defeat.webp` | 900×551, alpha | Empty lavender ribbon, crescent behind a cloud, sad bandaged mochi | text goes on the ribbon |
| `stardust.webp` | 256×313, alpha | Stardust (ผงดาว) currency icon: glass jar of glowing star dust | readable at 20–32 px |
| `chest.webp` | 512×504, alpha | Reward chest spilling stardust | run-end reward screen |
| `header-leaderboard.webp` | 1200×560 | Three crowned mochi on gold/silver/bronze podiums under the moon | leaderboard / profile header; crop with `object-fit: cover` |
| `og.webp`, `og.jpg` | 1200×630 | Share image: moon rabbit pounding mochi between two mochi heroes, logo on top | use `og.jpg` for `og:image` (widest scraper support) |

Style: moon night, lavender/indigo sky, glowing full moon, pastel pink accents, thick dark plum outlines (#3a2b33).

**How they were made.** `codex exec --skip-git-repo-check -s workspace-write --enable image_generation -C <scratch dir> "<prompt>"`
with the three prompt files in `scripts/assets/prompts/` (three images per run). Codex saves the PNGs under
`%APPDATA%\orca\codex-runtime-home\home\generated_images\<session id>\` (its sandbox cannot write elsewhere);
copy them into `scripts/assets/.cache/raw/` with these names: `bg-title.png`, `logo.png`, `bg-shop.png`,
`banner-victory.png`, `banner-defeat.png`, `stardust.png`, `chest.png`, `header-leaderboard.png`, `og-scene.png`.
Transparent art is generated on flat #ff00ff and keyed out. Then:

```bash
python scripts/assets/images.py            # key, crop, resize, webp (+ og.jpg with the logo composited)
```

Needs Python 3 with numpy and Pillow. The raw PNGs (~15 MB) are not committed (`scripts/assets/.cache/` is ignored).

## Sound effects (`assets/sfx/<name>.ogg` + `.mp3`, mono)

| Name | Use |
|---|---|
| `click`, `hover` | any button press / mouse-over (wired automatically by `initAudio({ uiSounds: true })`) |
| `buy`, `sell`, `reroll`, `lock`, `unlock` | shop actions |
| `pickup`, `drop` | drag a skill / drop it in a new place |
| `wish` | moon wish (พรจันทร์) sparkle |
| `fight_start` | fight begins |
| `hit`, `crit` | damage (crit = a big hit, ≥ 10) |
| `shield`, `freeze`, `burn` | shield gained / blocked, freeze applied, burn tick |
| `chain` | a trigger ⚡ bonus fires a neighbour |
| `ko` | someone's HP hits 0 |
| `win`, `lose` | after-fight jingle / sting |
| `last_chance` | last-chance choice appears |
| `champion` | 10 wins: run victory fanfare |
| `stardust` | stardust reward granted |

Made by `python scripts/assets/sfx.py` (numpy only): FM / additive bells, marimba, plucks, filtered noise, FFT
reverb, a gentle high cut, then every clip is levelled to the same short-term loudness (RMS of the loudest
100 ms ≈ −15 dBFS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS; ffmpeg `loudnorm` needs longer clips) and encoded to Vorbis q2 + MP3 64 kbps.

## Music (`assets/music/<track>.ogg` + `.mp3`, stereo, seamless loops)

| Track | Length | Mood |
|---|---|---|
| `town` | 53 s, 72 bpm | calm moon night: pads, bell arpeggio, music-box melody |
| `shop` | 40 s, 96 bpm | light / thinking: marimba, pizzicato bass, shaker |
| `battle` | 45 s, 128 bpm | upbeat: FM bass, plucked arpeggio, light drums |
| `victory` | 32 s, 120 bpm | bright celebration |

Made by `python scripts/assets/music.py`. Every note tail and the reverb tail wrap around to the start of the
buffer and the high cut is a circular FFT filter, so the files loop with no seam (they are played as looping
WebAudio buffers, which are gapless). Loudness: ffmpeg `loudnorm` I=−20 LUFS (music sits under SFX/voice),
Vorbis q1 + MP3 64 kbps.

## Voice lines (`assets/voice/<th|en>/<key>.ogg` + `.mp3`, mono)

Cute announcer / moon-rabbit lines, same keys in both languages (text in `scripts/assets/voice-lines.json`):

| Key | Thai | English |
|---|---|---|
| `welcome` | ยินดีต้อนรับสู่โมจิมูน! | Welcome to Mochi Moon! |
| `choose_hero` | เลือกฮีโร่ของคุณเลย! | Choose your hero! |
| `shop_open` | ร้านค้าเปิดแล้วจ้า! | The shop is open! |
| `fight` | เริ่มสู้กันเลย! | Fight! |
| `victory` | ชนะแล้ว! | Victory! |
| `defeat` | แพ้ซะแล้ว ไม่เป็นไรนะ | Defeat... you'll get them next time. |
| `close_fight` | สูสีมาก! | What a close fight! |
| `ko` | น็อกเอาต์! | Knockout! |
| `combo` | คอมโบ! | Combo! |
| `critical` | คริติคอล! | Critical hit! |
| `frozen` | แช่แข็ง! | Frozen! |
| `last_chance` | โอกาสสุดท้าย! | Last chance! |
| `champion` | ชนะครบสิบครั้ง! แชมป์แห่งดวงจันทร์! | Ten wins! Champion of the moon! |
| `perfect` | เพอร์เฟกต์! ไม่แพ้เลยสักครั้ง! | Perfect run! |
| `stardust` | ได้รับผงดาวแล้ว! | Stardust earned! |
| `new_day` | วันใหม่มาแล้ว! | A new day begins! |

Made with Gemini TTS (`gemini-3.8-flash-tts`), voices: **Zephyr** for Thai and for English (one character in both languages). Leda was also tried: similar clarity, Zephyr rated cuter/more natural in Thai (ASR rating 7.8 vs 7.2 cuteness), English was a tie, so one voice keeps the announcer consistent. Only the line itself is sent to TTS
(style instructions in the text get spoken aloud). Lines are generated one at a time per voice (rate limits),
then trimmed (silence removed at both ends), sped up 5 %, `loudnorm` I=−16, and checked by Gemini ASR
(`gemini-3.8-flash`): every exported line was transcribed back and matched its text. Result for the shipped Zephyr set: 32/32 lines match (Thai `ko` came back spelled น็อคเอาท์, the same word; accepted via `asr_ok`). Per-line transcripts and ratings: `scripts/assets/voice-asr.json`.

```bash
export GEMINI_ENV_FILE=/path/to/.env           # a .env with GEMINI_API_KEY=...; the key is never written anywhere
node scripts/assets/voice.mjs gen th Leda      # -> scripts/assets/.cache/voice/Leda/th/*.wav
node scripts/assets/voice.mjs asr th Leda      # transcribe back, prints OK/XX per line (+ asr.json)
node scripts/assets/voice.mjs gen th Leda --only perfect    # redo one line after fixing its text
node scripts/assets/voice.mjs export           # encode the voices chosen in voice-lines.json into public/assets/voice
```

Tip for Thai: prefer words ASR cannot mishear (e.g. "เริ่มสู้กันเลย" instead of a bare "สู้"); a loanword may come
back in Latin letters ("Perfect"), which `asr_ok` in the JSON accepts.

## Audio module (`src/client/audio.ts`)

- `initAudio({ uiSounds: true })` once at boot (done in `main.ts`). Sound starts on the first tap/click/key
  (autoplay rules); `music()` asked for before that starts then. With `uiSounds`, every enabled `<button>` plays
  `click` (add `data-sfx="none"` to a button that has its own sound) and mouse-over plays a soft `hover`.
- `sfx(name, { volume?, rate? })`: lazy-loaded, cached, throttled (same sound ≥ 45 ms apart, ≤ 6 per 120 ms, so
  skip / fast-forward does not machine-gun).
- `music(track | null, fadeSeconds = 1.2)`: crossfade between loops; at most two decoded loops kept in memory.
- `voice(key)`: plays the clip for `getLang()`; a new line cuts the previous one. `setLang('th' | 'en')`
  (default `'th'`) is for the UI language switch.
- `combatSfx(event, me = 0)`: one call per combat event → hit / crit / shield / freeze / burn / chain, KO, then
  win or lose jingle + voice.
- Settings: `getAudioSettings()`, `setVolume('master' | 'music' | 'sfx' | 'voice', 0..1)`, `setMuted()`,
  `toggleMuted()`; saved in `localStorage['mochi.audio']` inside try/catch (works without storage).
- Format: Vorbis where `canPlayType` says yes, otherwise MP3. A missing or broken file is skipped silently.
- Audio pauses while the tab is hidden.

## Sizes

| Folder | Files | Size (ogg + mp3) | ogg only (what browsers with Vorbis download) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `img/` | 10 | 828 KB | – |
| `sfx/` | 23 × 2 | 440 KB | 226 KB |
| `music/` | 4 × 2 | 2.6 MB | 1.3 MB |
| `voice/` | 32 × 2 | 764 KB | 434 KB |
| **total** | | **4.5 MB** | |

Nothing is loaded up front: images when the UI shows them, SFX after the first gesture (≈ 226 KB), a music
loop when its screen opens, voice lines on first use.
